title: Equal sensing and actuation expose a phase proxy failure without earning physical benefit
statement: Offline best of u=-.003,0,+.003 grants heat and phase objectives SAME three exact future branch rollouts, Q_T plus complex-mode sensors and matched power. Both pay calibration; not an online deployable controller. States19/22/27 choose heat actions-/+/- while phase chooses+/+/+: deltaQheat=-.000432399,-.000324316,-.000358912 versus phase+.000419712,-.000324316,+.000343436. Two of three phase-optimal actions worsen model heat; better phase/squared shear is not sufficient heat gain. Passive Gkeyll/TCV256 scans at u0 cannot identify unknown B(X): F+B1u and F+B2u share passive trajectories; large archives not downloaded. Hot-resonant physical source plus dressing/species heating and self-consistent gyrokinetic heat response remain unearned. Strong existing mode-converted RF/shaping/transport optimizers receive same hardware/sensing. Missing archive/code/tests/JSON/logs/proof/ledger were not acquired; REPRODUCE commands are data, not executed, and default output overwrite behavior is not invoked. Existing prior symmetry proof/report remain intact; nested archive integrity is source-reported only.

requires: Symmetric medium under ky sign reversal at equal frequency with Pplus=P(1+u)/2 and Pminus=P(1-u)/2, |u|<=1; one fixed signed spatial momentum channel.
Reported nonlinear mHW and passive-temperature exploratory floating-point models, specified fixed seeds, times and steps; source execution is reported rather than independently replayed.
Physically valid resonant momentum transfer, species-resolved local heating, stored wave dressing and source-to-zonal kernel must be independently acquired before physical application.

assumptions: Conditional source-reported RF/reduced-model pilot only. No acquired hot-resonant source-to-zonal kernel, self-consistent gyrokinetic ion/electron heat benefit, physical confinement advantage, independent scientific review or new Capital review overlay. The addendum supplies PASSIVE model-temperature flux and supersedes an earlier particle-proxy-only description; it does not supply temperature feedback on density/potential. Five fixed-seed descriptive heat intervals all include zero; long-time/coarse-step failures remain. Available final and two confirmed individual originals only; missing bundle/code/tests/proof/source-ledger/logs are UNRECEIVED. Producer archive-integrity and nested-byte-identity statements remain source-reported. No failed transfer retry, Library action, code replay, scientific reproof, novelty investigation or sign-off.
costs: Charge both beams and total absorbed power, real local heating mismatch, complete calibration, sensing, future-branch rollouts and actuator limits equally to strong ordinary control.
Reported model grids/time steps and finite tests do not give rigorous PDE intervals, stationary turbulence statistics, reactor power forecasts or useful confinement benefit.
